standard-dialogue.npc: You left the shrine. Did Zulrah reject your sacrifice?

steps.npc: Is that what you think? Board the boat again, and I am sure you will find Zulrah has overcome whatever pitiful attacks you used against him.

options.text: Remind me how this ritual works.

steps.player: Remind me how this ritual works.

steps.npc: Once I have brought you to the shrine, I will leave you there as an offering to Zulrah. You cannot use the boat to return.
You can use your magical powers to flee from Zulrah's grasp, though that would defeat the point of the sacrifice, and you'll have to try again.
When Zulrah inevitably kills you, I may be able to retrieve your dropped possessions. If so, I will hold them here.
Now board the boat and prepare to be sacrificed.

standard-dialogue-talking-to-her-before-.npc: Leave me, human, I have a sacrifice to prepare. If you wish for information, go and see the High Priestess.

standard-dialogue-attempting-to-board-th.npc: The sacrificial boat is not for you! Begone, and do not meddle in our sacred rites.

options.text: But I really want to ride the boat!

steps.player: But I really want to ride the boat!

steps.npc: You display complete ignorance of our sacred rites. Perhaps the High Priestess will consent to enlighten you.

standard-dialogue-talking-to-her-after-o.player: The High Priestess said I could offer myself as a sacrifice to Zulrah.

standard-dialogue-talking-to-her-after-o.npc: It is rare for a traveller to make such an offer! Very well, I shall explain the ritual to you...
Once I have brought you to the shrine, I will leave you there as an offering to Zulrah. You cannot use the boat to return.
You can use your magical powers to flee from Zulrah's grasp, though that would defeat the point of the sacrifice, and you'll have to try again.
When Zulrah inevitably kills you, I may be able to retrieve your dropped possessions. If so, I will hold them here.
Are you ready to face Zulrah?

steps.npc: I shall now transport you to Zulrah's shrine and offer your life on behalf of our tribe.

standard-dialogue-talking-to-her-before-.npc: You left the shrine. Did Zulrah reject your sacrifice?

options.text: I've been there, but I left.

steps.player: I've been there, but I left.

steps.npc: Well, board the boat and let me take you there again quickly, before Zulrah becomes impatient!

options.text: Remind me how this ritual works.

steps.npc: Once I have brought you to the shrine, I will leave you there as an offering to Zulrah. You cannot use the boat to return.

standard-dialogue-death-retrieval-dialog.text: If the player does not have anything to claim:

steps.npc: I'm afraid I don't have anything for you to collect. If I had any of your items, but you died before collecting them from me, I'd lose them.

standard-dialogue-death-retrieval-dialog.text: If the player has items to claim:

steps.npc: You left some stuff at Zulrah's shrine when you left earlier. I've returned it to you now.

standard-dialogue-death-retrieval-dialog.text: If the player has items to claim, but not enough inventory space:

steps.npc: You left some stuff at Zulrah's shrine when you left earlier. Clear some more inventory space and I'll give you the rest.

standard-dialogue-death-retrieval-dialog.text: If the player has items to claim, but no inventory space at all:

steps.npc: You left some stuff at Zulrah's shrine when you left earlier. Clear some inventory space and I'll give it back.

standard-dialogue-death-retrieval-dialog.text: If the player has items to claim and attempts to board the boat again:

steps.npc: You left some stuff at Zulrah's shrine when you left earlier. You'd better deal with it before returning.
